items.title: Amaziah the priest of Bethel
items.charge: Forbidding Amos to prophesy at the king’s chapel; sending to Jeroboam that Amos had conspired against him

items.title: Hoshea, last king of Israel
items.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord, though not as the kings before him; conspiring with So king of Egypt and withholding the tribute

items.title: Israel in the days of the Judges
items.charge: Making leagues with the inhabitants of the land; marrying their daughters and serving their gods; every man doing that which was right in his own eyes

items.title: Jehoahaz (Shallum) of Judah
items.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord according to all that his fathers had done

items.title: Jehoiachin (Coniah)
items.charge: Doing evil as his father Jehoiakim had done; a signet plucked from the Lord’s right hand

items.title: Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets
items.charge: Killing the prophets and stoning them that are sent; not knowing the time of her visitation

items.title: Manasseh
items.charge: Building again the high places his father destroyed; altars to all the host of heaven in the two courts of the Lord’s house; his children through the fire; observing times, enchantments, witchcraft, familiar spirits and wizards; a carved image in the house of God; Jerusalem filled with innocent blood from one end to another

items.title: Micah’s idols and the tribe of Dan
items.charge: A house of gods, a hired Levite, and a tribe that stole both and set up the graven image in Dan

items.title: Moab and Ammon
items.charge: Moab: magnifying himself against the Lord, trusting in his works and his treasures, and skipping for joy at the derision of Israel. Ammon: saying Aha against the sanctuary when it was profaned, against the land of Israel when it was desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity

items.title: Pashur the son of Immer
items.charge: Smiting the prophet of the Lord and putting him in the stocks in the high gate of Benjamin; prophesying lies

items.title: Pharaoh-hophra and Egypt
items.charge: Saying, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself; being a staff of reed to the house of Israel that brake when they leaned upon it

items.title: The captivity of Israel (the northern kingdom)
items.charge: Fearing other gods; walking in the statutes of the heathen; two calves, a grove, the host of heaven, Baal; sons and daughters through the fire; divination and enchantments; selling themselves to do evil

items.title: The captivity of Judah
items.charge: All the chief of the priests and the people transgressing very much after all the abominations of the heathen, and polluting the house of the Lord; mocking the messengers of God, despising his words, and misusing his prophets, till there was no remedy; the land’s sabbaths not kept

items.title: The marriage of the king’s son
items.charge: Making light of the call, and killing the servants who brought it

items.title: The sons of God and the giants
items.charge: The sons of God, the lineage of Adam, taking wives of the daughters of men of the other nations

items.title: The wicked husbandmen
items.charge: Beating and killing the servants sent for the fruit, and killing the heir to seize the inheritance

items.title: Zedekiah
items.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord; humbling not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the Lord; rebelling against Nebuchadnezzar who had made him swear by God; stiffening his neck and hardening his heart from turning unto the Lord God of Israel
